name: images
title: Image pipeline (AVIF/WebP) + favicons
summary: Automatic AVIF/WebP variants of every photo in public/, a `Picture` drop-in for `img`, and a full favicon/app-icon set from one source.
when: The site shows photographs (a gallery, a hero image, team portraits) or needs proper icons for tabs, iOS and Android home screens.
next: Put photos in public/ and render them with <Picture src="/photo.jpg" alt="…" width={…} height={…} /> (import from @/components/Picture).
Make icons: npm run favicons -- path/to/logo.svg --background "#hex" --name "Site name", then paste the printed <link> tags into index.html.
